'''Worldwide SWCCG Day''' was a day of Star Wars CCG tournaments held on 26 July 2008. The [[Players Committee]] announced the first ever Worldwide SWCCG Day on 13 July 2008 as part of its plans to bring new players to the game and to let others know that Star Wars CCG was still alive and played all over the world, from Australia to Europe.<ref name="pc-sid90">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=90 Worldwide SWCCG Day 2008], swccgpc.com (13 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080803140549/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=90 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

Tournament directors who wanted to run an event sent a private message to Cedric (forum name simone89), and players were told to check the tournament sections of the forums for events near them. The only special rule was that the event had to be held on 26 July 2008; everything else was up to the tournament director.<ref name="pc-sid90" /> The announcement was posted on the Players Committee website by a volunteer posting as tom_bitchev.<ref name="pc-sid90" />

== Virtual Set 16 previews ==

As an extra for attendees, four cards from [[Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith|Virtual Set 16]] were to be shown first at the Worldwide SWCCG Day events.<ref name="pc-sid90" /> On 26 July 2008 the Players Committee posted "V-16 Spoiler 1", showing four Virtual Set 16 cards: [[Coruscant: Night Club (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|Coruscant: Night Club]], [[Jedi Survivor (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|Jedi Survivor]], [[Myn Kyneugh (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|Myn Kyneugh (V)]] and [[Katana (V) (Virtual Set 16: Revenge Of The Sith)|Katana]].<ref name="pc-sid92">[http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=92 V-16 Spoiler 1], swccgpc.com (26 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080803131921/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=92 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Events ==

On 28 July 2008 Cedric opened a thread titled "SWCCG Day 2008 Results" on the Players Committee forum, asking tournament directors how many players had come to their events that weekend, who had won, and whether any returning players had taken part.<ref name="fsc-22101-318659">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318659#p318659 SWCCG Day 2008 Results], Cedric (simone89), Players Committee forum, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 July 2008).</ref> The thread, in the forum's "[General] 2008 Tournament Discussion & Results" board, drew 27 replies.<ref name="pcf-board348">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewforum.php?f=348 &#91;General&#93; 2008 Tournament Discussion &amp; Results], Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (board index captured 5 May 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100505221437/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewforum.php?f=348 Internet Archive]</ref> The events reported in it are listed below. The posts give the weekend rather than an exact date for each event; the Corellia Regionals in Indiana were held the day before the Indiana State Championship.<ref name="fsc-22101-318940">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318940#p318940 SWCCG Day 2008 Results], JakeA, Players Committee forum, forum.starwarsccg.org (28 July 2008).</ref> On 29 July Cedric asked whether anything had been heard from Europe; no reply in the thread reports a European event.<ref name="fsc-22101-319168">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=319168#p319168 SWCCG Day 2008 Results], Cedric (simone89), Players Committee forum, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 July 2008).</ref>
